caption: The drawing is composed of several geometric and floral motifs arranged in a grid pattern with distinct horizontal and vertical borders. The central area features a repeating block of stylized symmetric flowers and abstract shapes in navy blue, forest green, coral red, and peach arranged in rows and columns. The top and left borders contain floral elements in light peach with intertwining navy blue vine-like forms. The bottom border displays a row of green and navy blue potted plants with red flowers and complex blue stems. To the left, the text “MADE BY JOHN DENHOLM” appears with “MADE BY” in red and “JOHN DENHOLM” in green, and below this text are two horizontal navy blue stripes. The year “1844” is written in peach with a small star on either side below the text. The drawing uses a light cream background, and all motifs and text are made up of flat, filled areas of color with no shading. The entire composition is framed by a plain margin.
title: Coverlet
